title: Amazon Is Gutting Its AI Division After Sustained Failure
hook_text: Amazon is gutting its AI division.
script:
Amazon is scaling back its ambitious AI division after failing to see results.
The internal AI project known as Nova failed to gain any real traction.
The company is now moving staff away from these experimental generative AI models.
This shift follows a long period of sustained failure for the team.
Amazon struggled to keep pace with rivals in the competitive model space.
The decision marks a major retreat from its high-stakes artificial intelligence goals.
Will this move help them fix their core business issues?

editor.one_line: Too much filler and repetitive, static visuals that fail to maintain engagement.

LINE 4: Replace 'sustained failure' with a specific metric or internal report detail.

LINE 7: Replace the vague question with a specific business impact or stock implication.
